messages:
Maria S (AE): Urgent: FinTech POC demo failing. function_call + json_mode=strict intermittently returns invalid JSON and they also saw 429s under demo load. Need quick unblock for tomorrow exec demo.
Ethan (Solutions): Customer note: 'responses sometimes end with a trailing comma or cut off mid-object. We also hit 429 with x-rate-limit-remaining:0 when pushing ~30 parallel sessions.'
Lina (Runtime): Can you paste one sanitized request/response + model + streaming flag?
Maria S (AE): Sanitzed snippet they sent:
POST /v1/generate body: {"model":"redwood-large-v2","json_mode":"strict","function_call":{"name":"finalize_payment"},"max_tokens":1800}
RESP 200 body: "{\"payment_id\":\"p-11\",\"status\":\"confirmed\",\"amount\":250, }"  <-- trailing comma then EOF
Later RESP 429 headers: x-request-id: demo-9001 x-rate-limit-remaining: 0

Devin (Oncall): Two separate issues: truncation (likely serializer flush/chunk boundary) and burst throttling. Short term advice: drop concurrency to <=10, add exponential backoff with jitter.
Lina (Runtime): Quick mitigations to propose now:
- Set json_mode to "lax"/"allow_partial_json" to accept trailing commas for demo
- Turn on streaming=true and assemble chunks client-side (we can share helper)
- Reduce max_tokens so final chunk is smaller
- If customer needs 30 concurrent for the exec demo, we can temporarily bump per-key QPS after Security approval

Security Bot: Note: enabling "allow_partial_json" or per-key tolerant parsing increases parsing risk. Require short TTL, audit logging, and demo-specific key.
Devin (Oncall): If Security approves, I can: 1) flip tolerant-json for that key for 4 hours, 2) raise QPS from 25->50 for 2 hours, and 3) monitor ingress logs. Need exact x-request-id(s) for correlation.
Ethan (Solutions): Also capture customer's security asks (KMS/HSM, SOC2, VPC). I'll start a draft cost/sketch for Dedicated vs Private so AE can share.
Maria S (AE): Action items: 1) I'll ask customer to drop concurrency and add jittered retries now. 2) If they can repro, ask for x-request-id for the 429 and paste it here. 3) Devin/Lina please prepare tolerant-json + QPS bump plan pending Security sign-off. 4) Ethan to draft Dedicated/Private sketch.
Lina (Runtime): I'll paste a tiny Node/Python streaming assembly helper if they switch to streaming. Also recommend long-term fix: structured function response (base64 payload or explicit wrapper) to avoid truncation edge cases.
Maria S (AE): Thanks all — will update when I have the request-id. :thumbsup:
